Hero_Desc_Posher:
A so-called medicine peddler witch.
She brews potions and sells them in her potions shop.
Posher's potions are greatly effective but also come with great side effects as well.
Album_Like_Posher: When testing a newly crafted potion on someone. When unexpected results occur.
Album_Hate_Posher: Boring potion making requests. Food with a single flavor.
Album_Hobby_Posher: Clinical tests on junior level witches.
Album_Posher1: Posher is a potion master, a witch known for her knack for making potions. When it comes to lotions and potions, she insists her goods are the best.
Album_Posher2: The performance and efficacy of her potions are grounded in her ceaseless efforts and experimentation. When asked about her experiments were conducted, she glanced at Levi blankly, quickly changing the subject.
Album_Posher3: Before meeting Levi, she would test potions on herself. But now, she no longer uses herself as a test subject. Her dream in the long run is to join forces with the elves, mass producing the potions and monopolizing the potion manufacturing industry.
Album_Posher4: Posher sometimes cooks as well. She claims there's just a fine line between cooking and potion making... I discovered she was testing out a new drug by substituting flour with 'some strange white powder' in the cupcakes the sprites ate. I barely stopped her.
Album_Posher5: Posher does not understand the concept of taste when she cooks. She argues that if the ingredients are similar nutritionally, they are interchangeable. Though nutritious, Posher's cooking may be nutritious, but are not very good to eat...
Album_Posher6: At first, not want to disappoint Posher, I choked down her cooking, telling her it was fine. After that, she started feeding me things too bizarre to be even called cooking. It was my first time thinking I didn't want to die...
Album_Posher7: I was eating a dish made by Posher when Erpin walked by. The dish grabbed her attention, so I let her have a taste. From that day onward, Erpin smacked Posher on the head whenever she saw her. That was... unexpected. I never thought I'd see something even Erpin refuses to eat.
LoveHero_Posher:
Huh?
Stay attached to the
test subject?
Well, I don't mind.
LoveHeroCancel_Posher:
Are you putting out fire with gasoline?
Well...
I have nothing to say.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Hate1:
I feel like Posher doesn't like this dish because it's too textbook and hackneyed. 
She says she wishes it were a bit more experimental.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Hate2: Posher looked dissatisfied, asking if she was seen as a stereotypical witch who makes pumpkin potage.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like1: After smelling the dish, Posher slyly asked me for my recipe.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like10: She is smiling, saying that adding this to the medicine she is making would improve not only its flavor but its medicinal effect. What in the world is she making?
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like2:
After tasting this food, Posher looked deep in thought, like she was planning something. 
It seems she's curious about the manufacturing process.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like3: Posher looks as if she's thinking of a new formula, saying the powder will neutralize the bitter taste in the medicine she sells.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like4: Noting its pill-like structure, Posher asked how the dough was made. Regardless, it's probably for the best to not eat any songpyeon-shaped foods she offers.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like5: As always... she's plans to drug someone with it. If you ask her, you can cover any drug with enough flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like6: Posher says they should try adding tree logs to their own cooking. I told her that it's not actually a log but... she didn't listen.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like7: Posher dropped a few drops of a potion I hadn't seen before. It wasn't a medicine, just a seasoning she made.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like8: Posher said the taste reminded her of some elixir she had made, though in the end she couldn't remember exactly which elixir it was.
Food_ChefNote_Posher_Like9: Posher was not only impressed by the flavor but the composition as well. She thought it would be a good idea to create a gift set of potions with a similar concept.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Posher: If I mix a little bit of this with a little bit of that, I wonder what kind of effect will come about.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine3_Posher: Side effects are free of charge
Gacha_Result_Line1_Posher: Hehe, drink up! Don't leave a single drop.
Posher_Spawn2: What should I experiment with? // Lots of test subjects!
Posher_Growth1: I feel like I got smarter...

Posher_Victory1: Could make for a good potion ad, huh?
Posher_Defeat1: This new potion is a dud...
Posher_Defeat2: Maybe I need to reduce the side effects some more?
Posher_Affinity1_1: Mix this and that. Eventually, you'll get the potion you want!
Posher_Affinity1_2: Try this one! It's good stuff!
Posher_Affinity2: Good timing! I needed a test subject!
Posher_Affinity1_3: Buy one now and get another for free!
Posher_Affinity3: There's a delay in today's material delivery. Levi should have been here by now.
Posher_Affinity4: I mixed the ingredients until the potion turned black... which neutralized all its effects? What the heck?
Posher_Affinity5: There is such a thing as a tasty medicine... with a spoonful of sugar!
Posher_Affinity6: It is legal for witches to scam! ...Isn't it?
Posher_Affinity7: Do you want to try... a love potion sample? In the event that you experience any of the 27 different kinds of hallucinations, nausea, vomiting, or vertigo while taking it, please do not hold me liable.
Posher_Die1: The last combination was... cucumbers and peanuts...
Posher_Die2: I still have a lot of medicine left...!
Posher_Board: You want me to go here?
Posher_Stage: Time to test a new drug?
Posher_Touch1_1: It's okay to use a bit more force.
Posher_Touch2_1: I'm not used to this kind of thing!
Posher_Touch1_2: Ohh... I don't feel anything at all anymore.
Posher_Touch2: What are you doing? It's embarrassing.
Posher_Touch2_2: Yes, it does cheer you up a bit. I admit it.
Posher_DutchRubEnd2: Is this how you apply medicine?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Posher_Skin1: Posher is relaxing at home on a rare day off from her potion shop. She looks more affectionate and friendlier than usual.
Posher_Growth1_Skin1: Can I not rest a little longer?
Posher_Growth2_Skin1: I became stronger just by playing around and taking medicine.

Posher_Board_Skin1: Calling me on a day off is too much, you know?

Posher_Touch1_2_Skin1: Hmm? You want to play with me?
Posher_Touch2_Skin1: W-Wait. I haven't washed my hair!
Posher_Touch2_1_Skin1: Kyah! You scared me. Don't sneak up on me like that.
Posher_Touch2_2_Skin1: Mmm... a bit gentler. I feel just fine right now.
Posher_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ah! Why bother me during my break?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Posher_Skin2: Posher puts her busy shop aside for a while and heads to guitar practice for a performance. She gets scolded for arriving late every time, yet her steps toward the rehearsal room are always light.
Posher_Growth2_Skin2: Making potions while playing guitar is easy enough.
Posher_LevelUp_Skin2: I will not let you down!
Posher_Equipment_Skin2: A new guitar case? I will put it to good use!
Posher_HeroSkill_Skin2: Shall I show you what I can do on guitar?

Posher_Touch1_2_Skin2: Uah, you nearly made me mess up!
Posher_Touch2_1_Skin2: Mmm~ Now I want to play even better!
Posher_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: I can make a little mistake sometimes! That is so mean!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Posher_Skin3: An outfit for Posher to give her a professional image and build trust. It's said to be inspired by the elven researchers of Monatium.
Posher_Growth1_Skin3: Oh, I just thought of a promising formula.
Posher_Growth2_Skin3: Shall I present my latest research?
Posher_LevelUp_Skin3: The potions are really kicking in today!
Posher_Equipment_Skin3: Research always requires the latest equipment!
Posher_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: Results of the experiment show that the effectiveness has doubled!
Posher_Board_Skin3: Let's go look for some new materials!
Posher_Touch1_Skin3: I'd better have some sleeping pills on hand for next time...
Posher_Touch1_1_Skin3: Ugh, what the hell... the results were positive this time...
Posher_Touch1_2_Skin3: Physical changes caused by cheek-pulling... Analysis complete!
Posher_Touch2_Skin3: Oh, are you praising me for my research outcomes?
Posher_Touch2_1_Skin3: My heart's pounding... I must've taken the wrong potion...
Posher_Touch2_2_Skin3: It would be amazing if I could recreate this feeling in potion form!
Posher_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Ugh. You wanna end up as my lab rat?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Posher_Skin4: Posher has been offered the role of a nurse who leads clinical experiments for a dark organization. Somehow, this seems better suited to her.
Posher_Growth1_Skin4: At this rate, am I going to become far stronger than my test subjects?
Posher_LevelUp_Skin4: Hmm~ Which experiment shall I try first?
Posher_Equipment_Skin4: This is good protective gear. Now I can experiment with greater peace of mind.
Posher_HeroSkill_Skin4: I am very good at giving painless injections, hehe.
Posher_HeroUpgrade_Skin4: Now no one can stop me.
Posher_Board_Skin4: Where might my next test subject be~?
Posher_Touch1_Skin4: Do you want to become my test subject?!
Posher_Touch1_1_Skin4: The clinical trial results for the pain-removal potion are not in yet!
Posher_Touch1_2_Skin4: Are you not afraid of how I might react?
Posher_Touch2_Skin4: Hehe, it seems you were pleased with the experiment report?
Posher_Touch2_1_Skin4: This is not a bad reward either.
Posher_Touch2_2_Skin4: Mm, good. I will personally take care of you as a special case.
Aside_Upgrade_Posher1: My potions seem to be working better these days!
Posher_AsideGet: This is the ultimate potion! I'll make the flavor that everyone would like, no matter what!
Posher_AsideUpgrade: My potions seem to be working better these days! Hehe, I'm getting closer to my dream.

Posher_AsideUpgrade1: My potions seem to be working better these days!
Posher_AsideUpgrade2: Hehe, I'm getting closer to my dream.
Posher_SPSkill1_1: Hehe, what could this medicine be?
Posher_SPSkill1_1-01: Hehe, what could this medicine be?

Posher_SPSkill1_2-01: You can look forward to it!
Posher_SPSkill1: Wondering what this medicine is? You can look forward to it.
Posher_Ultimate1_2: A potion to make you prettier!
Posher_Ultimate1: A special potion! Become more beautiful, healthier, and exactly as you wish!
Posher_Ultimate3: Pumpkin! Sweet potato! Sweet pumpkin! Potatoes are pumpkin friends too, right?
Posher_PowerAttack1: Reagent No. 22. Take it all, and do not leave a drop!
Posher_Birthday: Happy birthday. I bought you a cake, so why have you not even touched it?
Posher_Gacha2: Glug, glug. Do not leave any; drink every last drop.
Posher_Gacha3: If I mix a little bit of this with a little bit of that, I wonder what kind of effect will come about.
Posher_Line1: Honestly, is cold medicine not something you take for the taste?
Posher_Line2: I need to balance the side effects a little better.
Posher_Line3: Creating a new disease would not be bad either. I can provide the medicine later.
Posher_Lobby: I need a more perfect medicine.
LoveLetter_Posher: Hey, Master, I've made a new potion. How about you come and give it a try?I've told you before, just like my potions, things that taste bitter are actually good for you, right? For you, though, I'll try making one that actually tastes pleasant. Don't get your hopes up, though... taste is all relative, after all. Hehe.Drop by when you have time. I'll be waiting.
LoveCall_Posher:
Master, want to hear something?
This time, it is not about potions!
There is an item I love using in the bath. Ah, I suppose it is a potion after all?
Anyway, dissolving this potion in bathwater feels absolutely wonderful.
It makes your skin smooth and warms your whole body.

But it is extremely difficult to make because it uses incredibly rare ingredients.
That is why I never sell it and have kept it entirely for myself.
For you, though, I could secretly spare one.

Does the Order have a bathtub? I doubt it...
Then come to my house. I will lend you mine.
Yes, that would be better! The instructions are a little complicated too, so I will teach you.
You had better hurry before I use it all myself.
That is how revolutionary this item is. Look forward to it.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_001: Any ingenious ideas for an elixir? I'm not sure what to make these days.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_002: An enchanting potion that makes you instantly famous.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_003: That's too common. Those don't really even sell anymore.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_004: Mineral water with the power of immortality.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_005: You don't need a potion for that. You can find it at any mineral spring.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_006: A dreamlike elixir that grants anyone whatever effect they desire.
Affinity_Posher_EP01_007: That's interesting. I can just use some plain water and sell it as a potion.
Affinity_Posher_EP02_001: You don't look well, are you sick? Would you like some cold medicine or something?
Affinity_Posher_EP02_003: Oh, here you go... Why am I staring at you, you ask? Well... I'm just observing to see if there are any side effects.
Affinity_Posher_EP02_005: Fine, your loss. Tch, failed this time, huh?
Affinity_Posher_EP02_007: Oh? Huh... I didn't expect this to happen, but I suppose it's all the same. The Sprite Queen has suddenly fainted!
Affinity_Posher_EP03_001: Did you know that there is actually no need for medicine in Elias? The herbs here are so potent, you see.
Affinity_Posher_EP03_003:
I mean, you can just grab and eat any herb you see around you to treat your pain or sickness.
Just keep shoving the herbs into your mouth and at least one of them would get the job done.
Affinity_Posher_EP03_005:
It's all marketing. To make a profit.
"Medicine far superior to herbs"!
Affinity_Posher_EP03_006: Is that why eating food here makes me feel healthier?
Affinity_Posher_EP03_007: Something like that... but using too many additives weakens the effect.
Affinity_Posher_EP04_001: There's another civil war among witches. So pathetic.
Affinity_Posher_EP04_002: You're a witch too. Aren't you interested in power?
Affinity_Posher_EP04_003: Me? I don't care about power. It's more fun to make and experiment with drugs.
Affinity_Posher_EP04_004: Have you ever wanted to live a quiet life?
Affinity_Posher_EP04_005: If it's too quiet, there won't be much business... so I just want them to fight in moderation.
Affinity_Posher_EP04_006: What do you think about the Witch Queen?
Affinity_Posher_EP04_007:
The Queen? She's okay, I suppose?
They say that the best leaders are the ones that give you nothing to worry about. In that respect, she's the best.
Affinity_Posher_EP05_001: No matter what happens, don't come into my garden, okay?
Affinity_Posher_EP05_002: I really couldn't care less about your garden. I just wanna live in peace.
Affinity_Posher_EP05_003: Good, good. It's always wise to follow a witch's advice.
Affinity_Posher_EP05_006: I didn't even know you had a garden...
Affinity_Posher_EP05_007: Oh? Really? That's weird... did someone trick me again? Pretend you never heard what I said.
Affinity_Posher_EP06_001: Ugh, I'm tired. This dang chronic fatigue just won't go away.
Affinity_Posher_EP06_002: You're a pharmacist. Don't you have a drug to treat it?
Affinity_Posher_EP06_003:
I got this chronic fatigue from taking drugs in the first place.
The more drugs I take, the worse it gets...
Affinity_Posher_EP06_005:
But sleeping feels like such a waste of time to me!
I could be using that time to research or sell more drugs...
Affinity_Posher_EP06_006: Attend our service and doze off, it should help you feel somewhat better.
Affinity_Posher_EP06_007: Wait, what? I can sleep during service? Great, I only stayed awake because I thought it'd look bad.
Affinity_Posher_EP07_001: I've been toying with the idea of starting a school for pharmacists... Do you think it would be worth the trouble?
Affinity_Posher_EP07_002: If you're prepared to open a bakery as a side job, sure...
Affinity_Posher_EP07_003:
Who do you think I am? I'm already selling medicine.
I have plenty of money, and I make enough money, too.
Affinity_Posher_EP07_004: Isn't it bad for business if there are more pharmacists around?
Affinity_Posher_EP07_005: I'll leave out the essentials when I teach, of course. It's only to make money off of tuition fees.
Affinity_Posher_EP07_006: Are you trying to contribute to the medical advancement of Elias? That's impressive.
Affinity_Posher_EP07_007: Uh... you don't have to make it sound so dramatic... but yeah... that's a nice way to put it.
Affinity_Posher_EP08_001:
I had a lamp with an elemental in it that grants wishes...
but I don't remember where I put it.
Affinity_Posher_EP08_002: An elemental like that exists...? W-Want me to help you look for it?
Affinity_Posher_EP08_003:
To find it first and make a wish?
I'm sorry, but I've used up the wish a long time ago. It's just a "lamp elemental" now.
Affinity_Posher_EP08_004: An elemental that grants wishes? Hmm... not a phantom?
Affinity_Posher_EP08_005: Elementals, phantoms, same thing. I can't tell the difference...
Affinity_Posher_EP08_006: I'll get Mayo or Marie for you. They might be able to help you...?
Affinity_Posher_EP08_007: Oh, you're getting your underlings to do it? Nice. I also pass off things to mine when I have bothersome things to take care of.
Affinity_Posher_EP09_001: Is the food provided here really different from the food I make? I can't tell.
Affinity_Posher_EP09_003: Hmph, The ingredients are the same, we just cook them differently. There can't be much difference...
Affinity_Posher_EP09_004: When it comes to food, taste is also important. Do you understand, Posher?
Affinity_Posher_EP09_005: I recognize that there's a concept called "taste." But is that more important than nutrition?
Affinity_Posher_EP09_006: If you really don't get it, why don't you take my place and cook for a day?
Affinity_Posher_EP09_007:
Sure, that sounds fun.
Ah, while I'm at it, can I add a few things to the dishes? Nothing much, just a little of this and a little of that. Ehehe.
Affinity_Posher_EP10_001: It's nice to see Levi getting healthier since she started working at my shop.
Affinity_Posher_EP10_002: You're not slipping her strange things when she doesn't notice, are you?
Affinity_Posher_EP10_003: I've never done that. Though I do occasionally give her stuff that's good for her.
Affinity_Posher_EP10_004: I guess she gets along with her employer.
Affinity_Posher_EP10_005: I'm happy as long as my employees do what they're told and do a good job of it. Levi is a good intern.
Affinity_Posher_EP10_006: Are you sure she's not gonna turn blue and get superpowers or something?
Affinity_Posher_EP10_007: That would be interesting. There are some drugs that have similar effects. Maybe I should combine them and give them to her?
Affinity_Posher_EP11_001: If you could have any superpower, which one would you want?
Affinity_Posher_EP11_003: Hmm. That would be popular with a sprite who's fanatically obsessed with the Master, wouldn't it? High profitability secured.
Affinity_Posher_EP11_004: The ability to create clones that work instead of me.
Affinity_Posher_EP11_005: If the clones break down every now and then, I could sell twice as many potions, right? Good thinking.
Affinity_Posher_EP11_007: So, the Master sometimes acts like a child, too... If you can fly, you probably won't go underground much, so that won't work.
Affinity_Posher_EP12_001: I'm thinking of making an innovative new medicine. When you have time, could you come by the shop?
Affinity_Posher_EP12_002: I don't want to be a test subject!
Affinity_Posher_EP12_003: Test subject? A fellow witch should know better. It's all for the Master and the Denizens of Elias, you know?
Affinity_Posher_EP12_004: Are you paying for part-time work?
Affinity_Posher_EP12_005: Of course... Just come by first. I'll explain the details later.
Affinity_Posher_EP12_007: Levi's coming anyway because of her part-time job. It'll be more fun if the three of us discuss the new medicine together.
Affinity_Posher_EP13_001: Business has been so good lately. Should I open a second potion shop?
Affinity_Posher_EP13_002: Where do you want to open it?
Affinity_Posher_EP13_003: Hmm... The Sprite Kingdom or Monatium are both good options, I think. Lots of loyal customers live there.
Affinity_Posher_EP13_004: Anywhere's fine, just don't build it near the Order.
Affinity_Posher_EP13_005: What?! Can't I build it anywhere I want, as long as I have the money? You don't want me nearby?
Affinity_Posher_EP13_006: Think carefully. Are you sure you're prepared for this?
Affinity_Posher_EP13_007: Hmm... There'd be a lot of annoying things to manage and deal with. I should probably put the second store plan on hold.
Affinity_Posher_EP14_001: Which flavor do you prefer sour, bitter, or salty?
Affinity_Posher_EP14_002: Why don't you mix them all together?
Affinity_Posher_EP14_003: Oh! Master, that's a great idea? Having just one flavor is boring.
Affinity_Posher_EP14_005: I think you've been living with the sprites too long. Maybe I should slip you a potion that changes your palate...
Affinity_Posher_EP14_007: Bitter and sour things are good for your body. How come you know one thing but not the other?
Affinity_Posher_EP15_001: Since you enjoyed it so much, I'll make dessert for you as a thank you.
Affinity_Posher_EP15_003: You mean you feel full just watching me eat? You don't have to turn me down.
Affinity_Posher_EP15_004: If you're making it, I'll gladly eat it.
Affinity_Posher_EP15_005: It's good for your body, so open wide. I put a lot effort into the taste, you know?
Affinity_Posher_EP15_006: I'll pass. You're going to put weird medicine in it!
Affinity_Posher_EP15_007: To reject it so bluntly like that. I hope you won't regret it later, Master.
Affinity_Posher_EP16_001: It seems like the underling witches are slacking off. It would be nice if everyone worked as hard as Levi.
Affinity_Posher_EP16_002: Time to establish some discipline here.
Affinity_Posher_EP16_003: Is it time to show the skills I've been hiding all along? Hehe.
Affinity_Posher_EP16_004: Isn't Levi working a bit too hard?
Affinity_Posher_EP16_005: Phew... Master, back in my day... Huh? Why are you covering your ears?
Affinity_Posher_EP16_006: Isn't there a drug that prevents slacking off?
Affinity_Posher_EP16_007: Master, did we have the same idea? I was trying to develop something like that, but I can't get that effect.
Affinity_Posher_EP17_001: Master, do you work out regularly?
Affinity_Posher_EP17_003: I figured as much, so I prepared a drug for that. It makes you feel like you've been running. What do you think?
Affinity_Posher_EP17_005: Thanks for asking, but I'd rather spend time making potions. A good potion can solve everything.
Affinity_Posher_EP17_007: Oh really? I have potions that enhance the effects of working out, so let me know if you're interested.
Affinity_Posher_EP18_001: The Witch Kingdom's hierarchy is too strict. I'm tired of only experimenting on lower-ranking witches.
Affinity_Posher_EP18_002: Isn't it better than the Dragon society?
Affinity_Posher_EP18_003: That society seems pretty tough, too. But I'm not a dragon, so it's not my problem.
Affinity_Posher_EP18_004: You can't experiment with potions on higher-ranking witches?
Affinity_Posher_EP18_005: That's right. Unless they volunteer to help.
Affinity_Posher_EP18_006: But you benefit from it, too.
Affinity_Posher_EP18_007: That's true, but it's best to experiment on creatures with a wide range of powers.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_001: Want to collaborate with me? We could sell medicine at the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_002: Selling pharmaceuticals at a restaurant is illegal.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_003: Wouldn't getting permission from the Sprite Queen solve that problem? That seems doable, right?
Affinity_Posher_EP19_004: I wonder if they would actually sell.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_005: We could have the Master's Apostles promote them for us. Give it a chance.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_006: I'll consider it if you make the potions taste good.
Affinity_Posher_EP19_007: No way! As I always say, medicine should be consumed for its nutritional value, not for taste.
Affinity_Posher_EP20_001: I'm feeling particularly bored today. Isn't there anything fun to do?
Affinity_Posher_EP20_002: Watch the Apostles come to the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Posher_EP20_003: Not bad. Observation is the first step of customer sales.
Affinity_Posher_EP20_004: Think of ideas for new medicines to develop.
Affinity_Posher_EP20_005: That's something I'm always thinking about, whether I'm resting or working.
Affinity_Posher_EP20_006: Don't you have a lot of work to do?
Affinity_Posher_EP20_007: I need to have days off, too. You don't want me to collapse from exhaustion, do you?
